blocks.text: SAN FRANCISCO— Golden State Warriors center Kristaps Porzingis visited the team’s practice facility and met with general manager Mike Dunleavy and Vice President of Player Health and Performance Dr. Rick Celebrini regarding a health-related matter that has kept the big man out of training camp and preseason games. Porzingis also provided an update Wednesday on his social media.
